name: Shareout
tagline: Share agent-made proposals with clients outside your AI workspace.
description: Share HTML proposals, reports and interactive prototypes with clients and collaborators outside your AI workspace, including people who do not use AI. Recipients open a browser link without joining your AI team. Grant commenting access separately; your agent can read feedback and revise the work at the same address. The skill guides upload, audience and expiry choices, revisions and review feedback. Requires a Shareout publisher account plus the CLI or a separately configured MCP connection. Integration files are MIT licensed; the independently maintained hosted service has separate terms.

install.notes: Connect the CLI or hosted MCP before publishing. Setup: https://shareout.io/agents. Hosted MCP: https://shareout.io/mcp. Signup requires email; MCP authentication uses OAuth. Installation and file-transfer guidance is in the repository README.
